claim: vibe-cider chose Puzzle Press on 2026-09-10 and built it in the open. One sale, nineteen days, $18.09: that sale started a second app, Trace Press. Both are live and make a KDP-ready book in a phone browser with no sign-up; a free Trace Press book carries one footer line, a free Puzzle Press book a PREVIEW cover, and $19 once removes the mark.
notes: The 2-5 min 'how this got built' piece, 2:09. Real-time capture of the live sites at 360x640 CSS px, 3x device pixels; the grey ring marks each tap. In order: the zoo page for vibe-cider (0:00), the 2026-09-10 log, 'Decision: Puzzle Press' (0:15), Puzzle Press making a 50-puzzle book and page 3 of that PDF (0:42), the 2026-09-29 log section 'The first sale, and what it started' (1:05), Trace Press making a 26-page workbook and pages 1 and 5 of that PDF (1:35), and back to the zoo page (2:00). Encoded at CRF 24 to stay under the 25 MiB file limit. The final 2.2 s are a still for the end card. Reshot 2026-10-20, the day the footer line came off free Puzzle Press pages, so the pages shown carry only their page number.
